events.text: Follow-on (same studiokit thread): mesh-op hotkeys shipped in 66b175f7f — extrude/loop-cut/flip/glass/detach/solidify/symmetrize bound (E/C/X/B/D/O/Y), each extracted to a shared guarded function used by both button and key, tooltips show the live chord, all rebindable in the Hotkeys panel. 11/11 controls tests pass.

resolution: Paint mode was a clutter/overlap mess: the context rail (left:8 top:72) rendered symmetrize + the lint badge — whole-mesh ops with no use while painting — directly on top of the floating PaintPanel (left:8 top:84: colours/materials/brush/detail/clear), so they interleaved in the top-left column. Fix: gate the symmetrize cluster and the lint badge on selMode !== 'paint', leaving the rail empty in paint mode so the PaintPanel owns the left column alone. They still appear in every mesh mode including rig (the req_1190 reason they were every-mode). Built green; can't self-shot paint mode (cold boot starts in object mode), so it needs a live look. SHA c1c7dc05f.
